# ifTable of the lab EdgePoint S16 (192.0.2.4, EdgeSwitch firmware 1.9.2),
# captured 2026-08-05 through the product's own diagnostic walk
# (POST /api/devices/{id}/snmp-walk, proxy-lab).
#
# Columns, tab-separated — ifDescr last because it carries spaces:
#   ifIndex	ifType (1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.3)	ifOperStatus (…1.8)	ifDescr (…1.2)
#
# What this capture proves and the tests replay:
#   - ifDescr is "Slot: 0 Port: N …", NOT the CLI/ifName "0/N" form.
#     The poller labels samples with ifDescr, so StandardPortName must take
#     this spelling or every sample fails facade resolution.
#   - ifIndex 1..16 are the RJ45 sockets, 17..18 the SFP+ cages: index equals
#     front-panel number on this hardware, all ifType 6 (ethernetCsmacd).
#   - ifIndex 65 (CPU) and 66..71 (link aggregates) also sit in ifTable, with
#     ifType 1 (other): both the ifType filter and the anchored ifDescr match
#     must refuse them.
#   - Only port 18 — the uplink to poefs3400lab XG1, LLDP-verified — and the
#     CPU interface were oper-up at capture time.
#
# ifName for comparison (1.3.6.1.2.1.31.1.1.1.1): "0/1" … "0/18",
# "CPU Interface:  5/1", "3/1" … "3/6".
